I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands on November 3, 2025.

- **Source:** Moss's Coastal digest of Nov 2, 2025 says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's own Dec 8 cutover recap also gives Nov 3 as the official date.
- **Day-to-day handover:** The recap says Bettina kept running the account day to day until Kwame fully took over on November 22, 2025.
- **Which date to use:** Nov 3 is the official change of ownership. Nov 22 is the date Kwame actually took over running the account. I told her to use Nov 22 only if the coverage tracker records who ran the account.
